d: A man returns home years after his brother was killed by a shark, but the shark is back. He must get revenge.
A rescue mission on a desert planet turns deadly when they find the planet's apex predators: giant sandworms.
Recovered footage of teens who break into an abandoned house and discover a cult intent on sacrificing them.
The Lupine virus turns Manhattan civilians into wolves. Unless a cure is found, only a nuke can stop it.
